subject: PO issuance request and line-item normalization — Nimbus Systems onboarding
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@nimbussys.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbussys.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO issuance and spend cap for Nimbus onboarding

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the walkthrough today. Attached are the completed vendor onboarding form and our initial SKU list (nimbus_po_request_form.pdf, nimbus_sku_list.xlsx).

We need a provisional PO so we can start provisioning access and billing: proposed provisional spend cap $75,000 for the first 60 days while we finalize SKU mappings. There are two SKUs that look like duplicates in our system (512A and 512A-1) — we'd like the PO to include both as separate line items for now and then merge if Redwood prefers a canonical SKU.

Can you assign a temporary PO number and confirm any required fields for Redwood's ledger? We also need any vendor-side onboarding checklist items to go live this week.

Vendor contacts: Ryan Cole (ryan.cole@nimbussys.com), procurement@nimbussys.com

Attachments: nimbus_po_request_form.pdf (pdf), nimbus_sku_list.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Ryan Cole
Strategic Accounts — Nimbus Systems
ryan.cole@nimbussys.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: PO issuance and spend cap for Nimbus onboarding

Team — forwarding Nimbus's onboarding request. They want a provisional PO and have two SKU rows that may need normalization (512A / 512A-1).

Requested provisional cap: $75k for 60 days. Vendor attached the onboarding form and SKU list. Can procurement confirm: 1) whether we can issue a provisional PO; 2) whether $75k needs finance approval (looks above typical onboard cap); 3) suggested PO numbering (provisional pattern), and 4) guidance on how to handle the duplicate SKUs as line items.

Ben — can you advise on ledger/COST_CENTER mapping?
Priya — can you take point on vendor follow-up and see if they can confirm the canonical cost center & any marketplace codes?

I need a quick turnaround as Nimbus is ready to start.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Vendor Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: PO issuance and spend cap for Nimbus onboarding

Rafael — quick notes from finance/procurement side:

- $75k provisional cap: this is above the standard quick-onboard provisional cap ($50k). We can approve $75k but need an exception ticket and finance sign-off (I'll open the ticket).
- PO numbering: we typically issue a provisional PO using the pattern PO-PROV-{year}-{seq}. I can reserve PO-PROV-2026-0984 for Nimbus until approvals are done.
- Line items: recommend we treat 512A and 512A-1 as separate line items for now but include a normalization note on the PO ("subject to SKU canonicalization"). Also include a zero-dollar placeholder line (LINE-0) for the merged SKU until vendor confirms split. That avoids re-issuing multiple POs.
- Ledger mapping: we need a COST_CENTER from Nimbus (or internal mapping to Redwood cost bucket). If they cannot provide, assign temporary internal code 600-ONB until reconciliation.

I will escalate finance sign-off for the $75k cap; Priya, please confirm vendor cost center and updated SKU mapping.

Ben Carter
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: ryan.cole@nimbussys.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: PO issuance and spend cap for Nimbus onboarding

Ryan — thanks for the form. Quick follow-up after a short call with your ops team:

- Vendor cost center confirmed: NIM-OPS-4001 (their finance gave us the code).
- SKU mapping: vendor sent a cleaned mapping and asked us to map 512A -> "ComputeBurst-Std" and 512A-1 -> "ComputeBurst-AddOn". I attached their csv (sku_recode.csv).
- Marketplace ID: not applicable for this onboarding.

Procurement recommendation: issue provisional PO at $65,000 while Ben completes finance exception for the additional $10k. If finance approves, we will amend the cap to $75k. Meanwhile we will include the placeholder line for any SKU merge.

Attachments: sku_recode.csv (csv)

Next steps I propose:
1) Rafael approves issuance of provisional PO with cap $65k and provisional PO number reservation.
2) Ben to finalize finance exception for +$10k.
3) Once finance responds, update PO via amendment.

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: priyam_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priy a_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-09T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: PO issuance and spend cap for Nimbus onboarding

Thanks everyone — approved to issue provisional PO with the following constraints:

- Issue PO as PO-PROV-2026-0984 (mark clearly as PROVISIONAL).
- Initial spend cap: $65,000 (per Priya). Include clear amendment clause so we can bump to $75,000 if Finance approves Ben's exception.
- Line items: include both 512A and 512A-1. Add a placeholder line (LINE-0) with $0.00 that references canonical SKU merge. Add a note: "Do not invoice against LINE-0 until SKU canonicalization complete."
- Legal: do not finalize PO issue until Legal confirms T&Cs in the DocuSign link below are acceptable. Priya, can you attach an invoice contact and ensure the onboarding checklist is complete before vendor provisioning?
- Monitoring: Ben, please set an alert to escalate to Rafael when vendor usage reaches 40% of the cap.

I approve issuance subject to the items above. Priya, once you have Legal confirmation, please finalize issuance and send the PO to ryan.cole@nimbussys.com.

Rafael Mendes
Vendor Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
